home.privacy: Children's photos are deleted automatically once the character is approved.

landing.lead: One photo from your phone and one drawing in their own colors: we turn them into a hero and a friend in an illustrated book with your child's name, printed to keep for years.
landing.privacyLine: We delete your child's photo automatically once the character is approved

how.title: Tell us about your child
how.body: Name, age, and what they love: space? animals? football? We build the story around them.

how.title: A photo and a drawing
how.body: A clear photo of their face, and one of their drawings if you like: it becomes their friend in the story. You approve both characters before we start.

how.title: Receive the book
how.body: Review the pages, change any words, then we print and deliver. Cash on delivery.

landing.themesTitle: Pick the adventure that fits your child
landing.privacyTitle: Your child's photo is safe with us
landing.privacyLead: We know you're sharing what's most precious to you. So {brand} is built on one simple rule: we use the photo only to draw the book, then we delete it.

privacy.title: Automatic deletion
privacy.body: The original photo is deleted from our servers within 24 hours of approving your child's character.

privacy.title: Parent consent
privacy.body: We never start without your explicit consent. In kindergartens, every parent consents personally.

privacy.title: No training on your children's photos
privacy.body: We never use your children's photos to train any AI model.

privacy.title: Delete everything in one tap
privacy.body: From your account you can permanently delete a child, their books and their data at any time.

landing.pricingLead: The preview is free. You only pay when you love the book, cash on delivery.

digital.desc: A PDF book and a reader on your phone.

hardcover.desc: The gift that lasts. Thick paper, glossy cover.

softcover.desc: Light and lovely for every night's reading.

landing.kgTitle: A graduation book for every child in the class, and every child is the hero
landing.kgLead: You upload the class list; we send consent links to parents, collect the photos, and print the whole class's books with a page for your kindergarten.
landing.kgHow: How does a class order work?
landing.faqLead: Didn't find your answer? Message us and we'll reply.

faq.q: Will the drawing really look like my child?
faq.a: Before drawing the story we show you a "character card": your child from the front and in two poses. We don't continue until you say it looks like your child.
We send you the expected delivery date when you confirm the order; it depends on the city. You can follow your order step by step from your account.

faq.q: What if I don't like the pages?
faq.a: You review every page before printing and can redraw any page. The preview is free, and you don't pay until you love the book.

faq.q: Can I edit the story text?
faq.a: Yes. In the review step you can edit each page's text, or restore it in one tap.
We're starting in Palestine; Jordan is coming soon.

footer.about: Printed picture books starring our children. From Palestine and Jordan.

themes.title: Story worlds
themes.lead: Each world is a complete, carefully written story your child enters as the hero, with their own name and face.
themes.empty: No worlds match these filters yet.

themeDetail.formatsNote: You choose the format after previewing the book. The preview is free.
themeDetail.soonBody: We're writing and illustrating its story now. Meanwhile, try one of the available worlds.

kg.title: A graduation gift every child, and their family, keeps forever
kg.lead: An illustrated book for every child in the class, with them as the hero, plus a page for your kindergarten, the class photo and a word from the teacher. You upload the list; we do the rest.
kg.flowTitle: Five steps, and most of them are on us

flow.title: Upload the class list
flow.body: An Excel file with the children's names and parents' numbers.

flow.title: We send consent links
flow.body: A WhatsApp message to every parent with a private link for their child.

flow.title: Parents upload photos
flow.body: Each parent consents, uploads a photo and approves their child's character.

flow.title: Pick the theme and your page
flow.body: Your logo, the class photo and the teacher's message.

flow.title: We print and deliver
flow.body: A class-wide review, then printing and delivery, wrapped with each child's name.

inside: The "My Graduation Day" story, with the child as the hero, by name and face.
Your kindergarten page: logo, class photo, and the teacher's message.
A "My class friends" page with every child's name.
A dedication page from the parents (optional).
kg.mockNote: "You were the stars of our class this year… we love you!"

trust.title: Every parent consents
trust.body: The kindergarten never uploads children's photos. Each parent consents and uploads their child's photo through a private link.

trust.title: Automatic deletion
trust.body: Original photos are deleted automatically once the characters are approved. The kindergarten sees the illustrations only.

trust.title: One official invoice
trust.body: One invoice per class or kindergarten, and books delivered wrapped with each child's name.

kg.formTitle: Let's prepare your class's graduation books
kg.formLead: Leave your details and we'll contact you within one working day to show you a printed sample and class prices.
kg.done: Request received! We'll contact you within one working day.

create.title: The story builder is being prepared
create.body: We're building the steps now: your child's details, consent, photo, drawing, style, character, story, preview and order. It opens here very soon.
